answer: Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the vault audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 156 to 264 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the echo identity is graded at all. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the harbor band is published for each class. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
